_doc: caves_east: Sapphire elevation 3 = 0, elevation 4 = 16 (Black 2's step per tile of rock); the plank bridges (cave_tiles.json bridge metatiles) are decks over a chasm, the elevation-15 crossings walk-under bridges (two collision layers). Origin (8,8) spreads it over its four chunks (a chunk file must stay under 110,600 bytes).
